items.title: Starbucks CEO: “The Shine Is Back.” Should You Buy After the Stock’s 30% Jump?
items.summary: Brian Niccol just declared the turnaround complete on national television, and the stock has already moved 30% to prove it. Before you buy into his confidence, there is one valuation reality and one unresolved risk that could flip the entire thesis.

items.title: CDC Declares Cyclospora Outbreak Linked to Iceberg Lettuce as Over
items.summary: The outbreak, which federal health officials linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from supplier Taylor Farms, resulted in a total of 12,883 reported cases of the gastrointestinal food-borne illness across 21 states.

items.title: These 5 Dividend Stocks Survived 2008, COVID and Every Recession Before Them
items.summary: Chasing the fattest yield on the screen is a trap most income investors fall into, but a handful of companies have quietly raised their payouts through oil shocks, financial meltdowns, and a global pandemic without skipping a beat. The question is what they all have in common.

items.title: SBUX Bets on Refreshers to Boost Afternoon Traffic: Will it Pay Off?
items.summary: Starbucks is betting on Refreshers to drive afternoon traffic, but rising competition from Dutch Bros and McDonald's could test its momentum.

items.title: America’s Fast-Food Chains Are Making a Big Pivot—Back to Humans
items.summary: McDonald’s and Burger King are boosting training to improve hospitality. “Our restaurants seem rushed, impersonal, sterile.”

items.title: New Whoppers, Higher Quality: Inside Burger King’s Big Revamp
items.summary: Burger King is making a comeback. The fast food chain has seen increased sales and foot traffic, which the company’s U.S. president Tom Curtis credits to their updated signature burger, the Whopper. WSJ’s Heather Haddon sat down with Curtis and visited the Burger King test kitchen to find out how they plan to make it last.

items.title: McDonald's Corporation (MCD) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
